title: kaam mushkilou me aaye sabki bigdi banaye
body:
kaam mushkilou me aaye sabki bigdi banaye
wo hai moula hamara ali ali
saari dunya bhulaaye use kuch bhi na bhaaye
wo hai moula hamara ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
qudrat ki banayi har sheh par, tu puri tarha se ghalib hai
murda zinda hoke jaaye, suraj bhaaga bhaaga aaye
jo ho tera ishara ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jiske ek ishare par maghrib se palat aaaye sooraj
sou jaan nichaawar chand kare, qadmou me bichaye sooraj
aisa mojiza dikhaye kuch samajh me na aaye
wo hai rab ka dulaara ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
hai achi tarha maloom use kiski choukhat par jana hai
dar asl sitaare ka maqsad kuch logou ko tadpana hai
dil ki dhadkane badhaaye na jagaye na sulaye
karta jaaye ye sitara ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
mushkil ki ghadi jab aan padi islaam ko jange qaibar me
bhandaar ye lashkar dekh ke ek halchal thi dile paighambar me
sab the sar ko jhukaaye tabhi jibreel aaye
aur goonja ye naara ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
is dehar me jinke sham o sehar kat'te hai bughze hyder me
un chehrou par lanat barsegi ye haalat hogi mehshar me
khade honge sar jhukaaye aur kahenge haye haye
nahi jinko gawara ali ali
<<DIVIDER>>
hontou par ali ka naam rahe is jism me jab tak jaan rahe
*naayaab* hamara tan man dhan sab moula par qurbaan rahe
mout ham ko na aaye jab tak ek baar
na dikhaaye rab rouza ali ali
